chunks: From him, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him)

A supplication regarding sustenance: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah! I ask You by the right of those whose right upon You is great, that You send Salawat upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and that You grant me the deed of what You taught me from the recognition of Your Right, and that You extend upon me what You have restricted from Your sustenance.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for increasing sustenance narrated from Imam al-Kazim?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication from Imam al-Kazim emphasizes the intrinsic link between spiritual knowledge (ma'rifah) and material provision, asking Allah to expand sustenance in exchange for the ability to act upon divine teachings. It reflects the Shia theological view that rizq is not merely material but is contingent upon recognizing and fulfilling the 'rights' of Allah and the Imams. The invocation highlights the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt as the means by which divine blessings are accessed.
